## Architecture

```
GZMO/
├── gzmo-core/           # Library: memory, pedagogy, gateway, control plane, MCP
│   └── src/
│       ├── config/          # gzmo.toml schema, split by section
│       ├── memory/
│       │   └── vault/       # SQLite vault, split by concern
│       ├── control_plane/   # Owner flock + memory.* socket API
│       ├── pedagogy/        # ZPD orchestration, EDF logging
│       ├── skills/          # Built-in skills
│       ├── tools/           # Tool registry
│       └── mcp/             # MCP server: gzmo_memory_* tools
├── gzmo-cli/            # Binary: subcommands, TUI, mentor IPC server
├── gzmo-chaos/          # Lorenz pulse feeding pedagogy tension
├── gzmo-scheduler/      # Job scheduling
└── crates/eml-core/     # Exp-Minus-Log symbolic engine
```

Two distinct Unix sockets, with distinct method namespaces:

| Server | Source | Methods |
|---|---|---|
| Control plane | `gzmo-core/src/control_plane/server.rs` | `ping`, `memory.search`, `memory.recall`, `memory.status`, `memory.turn_start`, `memory.chain`, `memory.profile` |
| Mentor API | `gzmo-cli/src/mentor_ipc.rs` | `ping`, `status`, `reload`, `teach`, `compute` |

The `memory.` prefix is required; the control plane rejects unprefixed methods
with `unknown method`.

Agents attach over **stdio MCP**, not over these sockets — see `docs/MCP_LOCAL_ATTACH.md`.

## Core pipeline

```
session-distill → honeypot-gate → spark-link → evidence-locate → promote
     ↓                ↓               ↓              ↓
  Extract         Qualify        Hypothesize      Verify
     └────────────────┴───────────────┴──────────────┘
                        ↓
              Promote to core memory
                        ↓
                Feedback tracking
                        ↓
                 Ripen (hourly)
                        ↓
                 Knowledge core
```

---

## Subsystems

**Memory** — SQLite vault with embedding storage and fact lifecycle; session
distillation; honeypot qualification gate with contradiction detection; spark
engine for cross-domain recall; RRF multi-source recall; ripen engine; episodic
file storage.

**Ownership** — one writer per vault, enforced by an exclusive advisory lock on
`{vault_db}.write.lock` (deliberately a separate file so it never mixes with
SQLite WAL locks). Acquired once at daemon start. Second acquirer fails closed.

**Ingestion** — file/directory ingest with dry-run; dream consolidation; wave
orchestration with dependency tracking; knowledge-graph reconciliation.

**LLM** — async OpenAI-compatible gateway with streaming, task→profile routing,
and fallback chains; sliding-window context management.

**Interfaces** — MCP stdio server (`gzmo_memory_*`); mentor IPC; control plane;
TUI; wiki layer as browsable markdown.

## Verification

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) gates every push and pull request:

```bash
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --all
scripts/baseline-refresh.sh --check
```

Reproduce locally with the same four commands. The workspace does **not**
compile on Windows: `tokio::net::UnixStream`/`UnixListener` are used
unconditionally. Build on Linux or under WSL.

Perf assertions are gated behind `#[ignore]` because wall-clock budgets are not
sound on shared runners. Run them deliberately:

```bash
cargo test --all -- --ignored
```

---

## Commands

```bash
cargo build --release -p gzmo-cli

gzmo serve            # claim the vault, bind sockets
gzmo status           # health + vault stats
gzmo mentor teach ... # client to a running daemon
gzmo dream            # consolidation
gzmo spark            # serendipitous recall
gzmo ingest <path>
gzmo memory dump
gzmo health
gzmo wiki sync
gzmo mcp-serve        # stdio MCP for agent attach
```

Product gates:

```bash
./scripts/keep-quality-gate.sh
./scripts/living-readiness-gate.sh
```
